subject: Basanta Kumari Patnaik profile
prompt: Create one landscape 3:2 literary editorial illustration for a Project Odisha article about Odia writer and publisher Basanta Kumari Patnaik. Follow Human Natural Image principles, Editorial Natural mode with a restrained poetic touch. Intent: show the care and everyday labour that turns writing into a book, quiet and inviting, not grand or nostalgic. A close oblique view of a simple bookbinding worktable. Two anonymous adult hands naturally holding an unlabelled small book block while a length of binding thread runs through its folded paper signatures. One hand supports the spine, the other gently draws the thread; physically coherent hands, fingers and thread. Two modest finished cloth-bound books partly overlap at one edge, a small pair of scissors lies off to the side, a few folded signatures rest nearby. Keep this sparse, not a flat-lay advertisement. Clearly hand-made editorial art: muted indigo ink outlines and matte ochre, warm cream and brick-red gouache shapes, selective detail and calm negative space. Use a markedly different visual vocabulary from an open book imagined as a theatre: no stage, curtain, audience or miniature people. Ordinary materials, plausible daylight falling from one side, no decorative dirt, excessive paper-grain filter or dramatic rays. No face, no likeness of Basanta Kumari, no historical scene claim, no book cover reproduction, no signature, no readable letters or pseudo-Odia script, no logos, no text. Central action should survive a card crop while the full landscape composition remains generous and balanced without perfect symmetry. This is a conceptual illustration of bookmaking, not a documentary photograph.
purpose: Accompany literary/publishing profile and provide unique card/hero image.
caption: Illustration: the work of turning pages into a book.
limits: Anonymous hands and conceptual bookmaking. Not Basanta Kumari's likeness, a documented historical workshop or a depiction of a specific story.
visual_inspection: Coordinator viewed generated result: two natural hands at a book spine, continuous thread, restrained palette, no readable lettering, no identity claim. Approved for local review.
